repo_notes.content: Jekyll 4 plugin (Ruby >= 3.3, < 3.5.dev) that minifies rendered HTML via the minify_html gem (post_render on pages/documents) and standalone .css files via lightningcss (site post_write at priority :high = 30).

Fork of gandaro/jekyll-minify-html-rs, dual-licensed: upstream code MIT (LICENSE.MIT), fork work AGPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE); every file carries an SPDX header — see AGENTS.md for the provenance table.
required_ruby_version capped < 3.5.dev because minify_html 0.18.1 declares Ruby < 3.5.dev and ships no Ruby 4.0 native binary (wilsonzlin/minify-html#278).
CSS pipeline order: sass-converter compiles .scss first, then the post_write pass minifies every written .css; runs ahead of Fingerprint Flow (11-19) and Compress Flow (0-10).

Config: minify_html map for inline HTML/CSS/JS minification (minify_html gem Cfg options), minify_css top-level map for standalone CSS (enabled, minify, error_recovery, targets, css_modules, scope); invalid values fail the build.
Tests are Minitest: real Jekyll site builds in tmpdirs, plus test/system/ which extracts the packaged .gem and runs a real jekyll build against it. See AGENTS.md for conventions.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Two-hook design: page/document post_render -> minify_html (HTML + inline CSS/JS); site post_write :high -> lightningcss over site.dest/**/*.css. Config validation at registration time fails the build on bad values

page_notes.content: Include Mermaid diagram: render -> post_render HTML minify -> write -> post_write CSS pass -> fingerprint/compress flows
